content: The SecOC module shall report the verification status of the corresponding secured Rx - PDU as follows: If SecOCRxPduProcessing/SecOCClientServerVerificationStatusPropag ationMode is set to BOTH or FAILURE_ONLY , the verification status shal l be served through the service interface SecOC_VerificationStatusIndication according to its current configuration. No report will be provided if the configuration is set to NONE
